notes.title: DEAD METRO Play Test Offline
notes.content:
We would like to thank all players who participated in our playtest, but for now, we have to stop enjoying the game for now.

Dead metro playtest is part of system testing. of the game only The right to enter the game is reserved for the developer only.

But the fun doesn't end there because we have a demo for you all to try out.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3201690

Team up with your friends to survive and fight through hordes of zombies in Dead Metro.

Thankyou.
